topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Finding out that my partner has been penning a novel about me, the world seems a tad brighter today. Each page, each word, a thread in the intricate tapestry of our life, woven with care and thought. It’s a delightful surprise, this secret garden of stories they've cultivated, reflecting the moments we've shared. The characters in the margins, the landscapes woven in the interludes—all feel like familiar friends, echoing the whispers of our adventures. It’s a gift, one that speaks volumes about the depth of their affection and the richness of our journey together. To be so deeply seen and cherished, captured in ink and woven into tales, is a privilege and a joy.
